info.name: Leave Booking System - MANUAL
info.description:
Manual testing collection — paste real tokens and IDs into each request.
Replace PASTE_ADMIN_TOKEN, PASTE_MANAGER1_TOKEN, PASTE_STAFF1_TOKEN etc. with real JWT tokens from login responses.
Replace PASTE_*_UID with real Firebase UIDs from register/login responses.
Replace PASTE_LEAVE_REQUEST_ID / PASTE_ALLOWANCE_ID with real IDs from create responses.

No environment variables. No test scripts. Pure manual step-by-step.
